nodes.summary: The characteristic polynomial of a Hermitian complex matrix is real-rooted.
nodes.title: Hermitian matrices have real-rooted characteristic polynomials

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a positive semidefinite complex square matrix indexed by a nonempty finite set. Then the operator norm of $A$ with respect to the Euclidean ($\ell^2$) norm equals the largest real part of a root of the characteristic polynomial of $A$. Since these roots are real, this is its largest root.
nodes.title: Spectral norm of a positive semidefinite matrix
